## GPT-5.5 API

GPT-5.5 is a large language model by OpenAI, available on the Venice API as `openai-gpt-55`. The provider of this model may retain prompt data (though it is anonymized by Venice). For sensitive content, use a private model.

GPT-5.5, the successor to GPT-5.4, is a frontier model in the GPT-5 series with a 1M+ context window, offering improved agentic and long context performance. It uses adaptive reasoning to dynamically allocate computation across tasks.

### GPT-5.5 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `openai-gpt-55` | Standard | Anonymized | $5.00 / $30.00 per 1M |

### How to use the GPT-5.5 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses` with `"model": "openai-gpt-55"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/responses \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "openai-gpt-55",
    "input": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences.",
    "reasoning": { "effort": "high" }
  }'
```
